subject: [hw] DONE V10 rev 3
body:
V10 rev 3: integration is now green end-to-end (no review findings received; this is the
tree-level confirmation that was missing from rev 2).

1. Package test (unchanged implementation, 542 cases):
    $ bash gpu/hwcodec/emu/test_v10/run_tests.sh
    N2TEST V10 PASS 220589/220589
    (ASan+UBSan -O1 and plain -O2, identical lines)

2. Optional core routing check through T01's asmrun and V02's real core:
    $ bash gpu/hwcodec/emu/test_v10/check_routing_v10.sh
    V10-ROUTE PASS 12/12
   12 snippets: ALU immediate, ALU register, immediate shifts incl. RRX/LSR#32/ASR#32,
   shift-by-register (incl. the ASR case that was misrouted until 12:11), MOVW/MOVT,
   MUL/MLA/MLS, UMULL/UMLAL/SMULL/SMLAL/UMAAL, MRS/MSR APSR, CLZ, ADR, ALU write of PC,
   TST/TEQ/CMP/CMN. The one earlier failure (0xe0800351 add r0,r1,r2,asr r3 -> arm_media) was
   reported with the exact fix and hw-v02 fixed it at 12:11.

3. Official T01 differential harness, in-tree, my ten kernels installed by T01 as
   tests/emu/kernels/k10_v10_dp.c (bash gpu/hwcodec/tests/emu/run_diff.sh, 97 kernels x 20
   seeds x 7 configs, core of 12:11):
       configuration    calls     pass mismatch     stop  missing
       arm-O0           1940     1700        0      240        0
       arm-O2           1940     1212        0      728        0
       arm-O3v          1940     1392        0      548        0
       thumb-O0         1940       25       15     1900        0
       thumb-O2         1940      858       33     1049        0
       thumb-O3v        1940      898       33     1009        0
       armv8-O3v        1940     1426        0      514        0
   **No k_v10_* call stops in any ARM configuration and ARM mismatch count is 0** (checked the
   four per-configuration logs). The thumb failures are T32 32-bit classes (V15-V20) and other
   packages' mismatches, not V10. The overall N2TEST T01 FAIL is therefore not caused by this
   package; the arm rows still show stops from memory/VFP/NEON kernels of other classes.

Not done / open (unchanged):
- D01 census (12:02) says zero reachable A32 instructions in the vendor set (all 2375 FUNC
  symbols Thumb), so the "no used mnemonic returned UNDEF" acceptance check holds vacuously;
  V10 is not on the vendor hot path, as recorded in STATUS.md.
- MRS CPSR value (APSR | 0x1D0 | T | IT) is a documented choice; V16 has the formula.
- MSR with control/x mask returns UNDEF rather than ignoring the write (documented; no A32
  vendor code exists).
- No phone, no real ARM hardware: execution evidence is the native x86-64 differential
  harness plus llvm-mc encodings and ARM-ARM literals.

Files: gpu/hwcodec/emu/n2a32_arm_dp.c (unchanged since rev 1); gpu/hwcodec/emu/test_v10/
{run_tests.sh, mkenc.py, encodings.txt, cases_v10.inc, undef_v10.inc, t_dp.c, gen_cases.py,
k10_dp.c, check_routing_v10.sh, STATUS.md}; gpu/hwcodec/dsh-state/workers/V10/STATUS.md.
